labels.name: similar_projects
labels.description: Nearest projects to a given slug by visual + semantic similarity (precomputed SigLIP neighbours). Use the slug from search_projects results.

labels.name: get_project
labels.description: Full metadata for one project: machine-written description, design language, details and dimensions, plus the public URL.

labels.name: search_by_taste
labels.description: Search by taste metadata: material, light, color, mood, composition, subject. Unique to Thisispaper: these tags were written during human curation. Provide at least one dimension; results are ranked by how many dimensions match, then by recency.

labels.name: browse
labels.description: Newest projects in the archive first, optionally filtered by category: architecture, interiors, design, photography or art.

labels.name: discover
labels.description: One project chosen at random from the archive. Editorial serendipity: the way a reader opens a magazine to an unplanned spread.

labels.name: get_api_key
labels.description: Mint a FREE Thisispaper Intelligence API key (200 calls/month) for an email address. The key is shown once; use it as Authorization: Bearer tip_live_... on this MCP endpoint and on the REST API. Max 3 keys per email.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_projects, get_project, get_api_key · Private data: fetch, search_projects, get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_projects, get_project, get_api_key · Private data: fetch, search_projects, get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, search_projects, get_project, list_guides, get_api_key · Private data: fetch, search_projects, get_api_key · Public sink: get_api_key
remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

remediation.title: Tool description changed since last scan
remediation.detail: Tool "search" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search nearly 2,500 hand-curated architecture, design, photography and art projects from Thisispaper. Returns a list of results with id, title and url." → after: "Search 2,500+ hand-curated architecture, design, photography and art projects from Thisispaper. Returns a list of results with id, title and url."

remediation.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
